about: 'note' is shown under the stack picker. Numbers: companion/config/evidence.json and results/phase_b/report.md (TradingView 5m data, 8 symbols, the app's taken trades on the current engine, market entry, 2R, net of costs). No stack showed a durable edge net of costs.

stacks.name: 1D / 1h / 5m
stacks.note: Backtest 2021, 2024-26: -0.08 R a trade (n 2,262), negative every year tested. The weakest stack measured.

stacks.name: 1D / 4h / 15m
stacks.note: Backtest 2021-26: +0.04 R a trade (n 1,008), up in 4 of 6 years. The best stack measured, but not significant: not an edge.

stacks.name: 1W / 4h / 15m
stacks.note: Backtest 2024-26: 0.00 R a trade (n 361), up in 1 of 3 years. No edge.
